title: PerfectLocalModelsStageGluing
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R:I → CommRingCat a system, c a colimit cocone, i an index, and t:Z → Spec R_i locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Fix shared derived module categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Given j≥i, put Y_j=Z times_{R_i} R_j and X=Z times_{R_i} c.pt, and let g_j:X → Y_j be the canonical base-change map induced by c_j. Let U,V be compact opens covering Y_j, A and B perfect complexes on U and V [def-pc-perfect-complex], and E any derived object on X. Suppose specified isomorphisms L(g_j|U)^*A ≅ E|_{g_j inverse U} and L(g_j|V)^*B ≅ E|_{g_j inverse V}, with canonical open restrictions [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. Then there exist k≥j, an object F of the derived category on Y_k, and a morphism a:Lg_k*F→E. Each point of Y_k has an open neighbourhood W such that LW.ι*F is perfect; each point of X has an open neighbourhood W on which the exact open restriction of a is invertible. These are neighbourhood witnesses for perfectness and invertibility; adjunction and local maps into derived direct image are not asserted.

source.place: Tag 09RF, two-open induction including the application of Tag 08DG

proof.text: Obtain a stage object F, a two-open cover whose pulled restrictions are perfect, and local limit isomorphisms satisfying the explicit overlap equality.

Inverse images of the original covering opens cover X. Apply derived Hom Mayer-Vietoris exactness to the homs of the compatible localized-site isomorphisms: their difference on the overlap is zero, so a global map a exists with exactly those two restrictions.

At each stage point choose a member of the supplied stage cover and its perfectness proof. At each limit point choose a member of the inverse-image cover. Rewrite its localized restriction of a to the supplied isomorphism hom. Apply the exact open-site equivalence and transport invertibility along mapDerivedCategoryCompIso, using NatIso.isIso_map_iff, to obtain invertibility for schemeOpenRestriction. Return k,F,a and these two pointwise witness families.

lean.statement:
theorem perfect_local_models_stage_gluing
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (i : I) (Z : Scheme.{u}) (t : Z ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation t] [QuasiCompact t] [QuasiSeparated t]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens),
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    :
    let Yj := pullback t (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))
    let X := pullback t (Spec.map (c.ι.app i))
    let gj := baseChangeMap t
      (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij))))
      (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))
      (Over.homMk (Spec.map (c.ι.app j))
        (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, c.w (homOfLE hij)]))
    ∀ (U V : Yj.Opens) (_hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤)
      (_hU : IsCompact (U : Set Yj)) (_hV : IsCompact (V : Set Yj))
      (A : schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme) (B : schemeDerivedCategory V.toScheme)
      (_hA : U.toScheme.IsPerfect A) (_hB : V.toScheme.IsPerfect B)
      (E : schemeDerivedCategory X)
      (_φU : (derivedPullback (gj ∣_ U)).obj A ≅
        (schemeOpenRestriction X (gj ⁻¹ᵁ U)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E)
      (_φV : (derivedPullback (gj ∣_ V)).obj B ≅
        (schemeOpenRestriction X (gj ⁻¹ᵁ V)).mapDerivedCategory.obj E),
    ∃ (k : I) (hjk : j ≤ k),
      let g := baseChangeMap t
        (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))))
        (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)))
        (Over.homMk (Spec.map (c.ι.app k))
          (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, c.w (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk))]))
      ∃ (F : schemeDerivedCategory
          (pullback t (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk))))))
        (a : (derivedPullback g).obj F ⟶ E),
        (∀ x : (pullback t (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk)))) : Scheme.{u}),
          ∃ W : (pullback t (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk))))).Opens,
            x ∈ W ∧ W.toScheme.IsPerfect ((derivedPullback W.ι).obj F)) ∧
        (∀ x : (pullback t (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)) : Scheme.{u}),
          ∃ W : (pullback t (Spec.map (c.ι.app i))).Opens, x ∈ W ∧
            IsIso ((schemeOpenRestriction _ W).mapDerivedCategory.map a))
